hotels.title: Stylish Caroline Springs Escape in Melbourne’s West
hotels.description: Discover polished lakeside living in Melbourne’s west at this contemporary retreat in Caroline Springs, overlooking the tranquil waters of Lake Caroline. Spacious rooms and suites are paired with an indoor heated pool, spa, sauna and a modern fitness centre. Step outside for waterside strolls, boutique shopping and easy dining at Caroline Springs Square, or settle in at WestWaters Bistro for steaks, seafood and lake views. CS Square Village Cinemas, the leafy trails of Kororoit Creek and cellar doors in the nearby Sunbury wine region are all within easy reach
